The strictest data class among the composed snippets is the one the input-context gate applies to every send through this configuration. To keep it out, deactivate the snippet or remove the tag from it before installing.

Skills
A pack installs no skills. A skill carries provenance and a trust level from the source it was synced from, and a pack cannot produce either. Add a skill source instead.
